parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query. If the NextToken parameter is empty, no subsequent requests are sent.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Auto Scaling resource.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the Auto Scaling resource. Set the value to scalinggroup, which indicates that the tag is bound to a scaling group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess list-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --page-size 10 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ess ListTagKeys --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --PageSize 10 --ResourceType scalinggroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
